description: A shell script containing tests for Git worktree references, including setup, resolution, ambiguity checks, reflog verification, and for-each-ref listing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares the revision of a reference to an expected value.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.
